subject: Bellevue Pond Invasive Plant Management
overview: The Commission reviewed and approved an invasive species management plan for Bellevue Pond as an ecological restoration project. Members also discussed upcoming development filings and maintenance projects throughout the city.

items.title: 400 Mystic Avenue RDA
items.summary: Tabled the request for determination of applicability for 400 Mystic Avenue until the July 6 meeting.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Bellevue Pond Invasive Management
items.summary: Approved a five-year order of conditions for the Department of Conservation and Recreation to conduct invasive plant management at Bellevue Pond. The project involves targeted herbicide application and manual removal of species like Japanese knotweed to enhance rare species habitat.

items.title: Future Project Updates
items.summary: Discussed the status of a pending filing for the former Bertucci's building on Fellsway Parkway and potential emergency paving work at the LoConte Rink parking lot.
